acceptance: Exact rational exposure, endpoint distributions, terminal mass, all survival cases and named/synthetic bookkeeping outcomes agree, with mass conservation and invalid-input rejection.
attempt_policy: Exclusive result directory and receipt; exact matrix, no selective retries or threshold tuning. Preserve errors and partial trace; code fixes require a new identified calibration attempt.
availability: Reaching the requested successful-event index is required. Return reached/surviving-reached/consumed-reached/unavailable probability masses and conditional survival only when reached mass is positive. Terminal paths are not padded. Domain errors reject the whole request.

exposure.oracle: direct ordered pairs and target-intersection counting versus adjacency-join incidence accounting
exposure.targets: every subset of distinct initial occurrence IDs, including empty

next: Separately register G2 campaign feasibility and measurement-domain/budget design, then pilot and source-bound launch.
paired_scope: synthetic endpoint arithmetic only; parent/split/scheduler/horizon inheritance; expose initial and endpoint match-count differences; no dropping unavailable pairs or claiming a valid matched sham from equal counts

survival.oracle: explicit weighted labelled histories, direct occurrence-pair matching and separate endpoint substitution; compare full endpoint distribution and termination-by-depth mass to aggregated state DP
survival.scheduler: uniform over all ordered eligible distinct occurrence pairs; no RNG sampling
survival.targets: every subset of initial occurrence IDs, including empty; identities never regenerated
